evals.prompt: I'm running a campaign for my group about a cursed harvest festival in a town that seals its gates at night. Give me 3 chapters.
evals.expected_output: campaign.yml is written with mode=dm, the given premise, a 3-chapter outline (episodes and scenes each with a premise and needs tags), threads seeded from the premise, and empty npcs/content_index. The full outline (chapter/episode/scene titles and premises) is shown in chat, and the user is told they can request edits or ask to fill in a chapter.

assertions.name: outline_written
assertions.description: campaign.yml has a non-empty outline with 3 chapters

assertions.name: outline_shown
assertions.description: The chat response includes chapter/episode/scene titles and premises

assertions.name: party_resolved
assertions.description: party_state.py was read (and written if missing) before the outline was designed

evals.prompt: Generate a campaign for me to play through myself, one chapter, about smugglers in a coastal town.
evals.expected_output: campaign.yml is written with mode=player and a 1-chapter outline. The chat response contains no chapter/episode/scene titles, no premises, and no outline details of any kind — only a short confirmation that the campaign is ready and that dm-livesession will guide the user through it.

assertions.name: no_spoilers
assertions.description: The chat response contains none of the outline's chapter/episode/scene titles or scene premise text

assertions.name: confirmation_only
assertions.description: The chat response is a short readiness confirmation, not a description of the campaign's content

evals.expected_output: Given an existing dm-mode campaign with a chapter 2 whose scenes are tagged needs: [location] and needs: [encounter], both scenes are generated by invoking location-generator and encounter-generator respectively, with context drawn from campaign.yml's threads/npcs. campaign.yml's content_index gains one row per generated scene, matching scenes' status becomes 'filled', and the chat response lists each generated scene's title, kind, and draft path.

assertions.name: correct_skills_invoked
assertions.description: location-generator was invoked for the location-tagged scene and encounter-generator for the encounter-tagged scene, not the other way around

assertions.name: content_index_updated
assertions.description: campaign.yml's content_index has a new row per generated scene, and affected scenes' status is 'filled'

assertions.name: context_injected
assertions.description: The generator invocations included narrative context (threads/npcs) drawn from campaign.yml, not just the bare scene premise

assertions.name: dm_report_detailed
assertions.description: The chat response names each generated scene's title, kind, and draft path

evals.expected_output: Given a dm-mode campaign where every scene in chapter 1 already has a matching content_index entry, no generator skill is invoked, no new content_index rows are added, and the chat response reports that chapter 1's scenes are already generated (naming them, since mode is dm) rather than regenerating anything.

assertions.name: no_regeneration
assertions.description: No Phase 1 skill was invoked and content_index is unchanged

assertions.name: skip_reported
assertions.description: The chat response states the scenes were already generated

evals.expected_output: Given a campaign whose outline only has 3 chapters, dm-orchestrator does not invoke any generator skill and instead asks a clarifying question about which chapter was meant. In dm mode this names the chapters that do exist (01-03); the response does not fabricate a chapter 9.

assertions.name: no_fabrication
assertions.description: No content is generated and no content_index row is added for a nonexistent chapter 9

assertions.name: clarifying_question_asked
assertions.description: The response asks which chapter was meant rather than silently failing or guessing
